facts.description: The app serves at least one page behind auth middleware.
The app serves at least one page without auth middleware (beyond auth screens).
The app has login, password reset or email verification routes.
The app has a team, organisation or workspace model that users belong to.
The app defines a Mailable or Notification with a mail channel.
The app requires laravel/mcp or registers an MCP server.
The app has account or workspace settings pages.
The app has a search route or a global search box.
An app-owned route deletes records or performs an irreversible action.
An app-owned page posts, puts or patches a form.
An app-owned form shows a value derived from other inputs (totals, previews).
An app-owned page lists records with paging, sorting or filtering.
An app-owned page renders an activity, history or audit timeline.
An app-owned form takes files.
An app stores or edits rich-text or HTML content.
An app-owned page shows a list beside a detail or preview pane.
An app-owned page edits an ordered sequence of items with a live preview.
The app has an editor, builder or preview screen: the kit's Workbench, or a component named for one.
The app opts in to passkeys: its user model implements Fortify's PasskeyUser, or a page offers the kit's passkey prompt. Passkeys are optional per app.
An app-owned page or component opens a dropdown or action menu.
An app-owned page or component opens a modal, dialog, sheet or popover.
An app-owned page or component shows a person's or workspace's picture or initials.
An app-owned page or component shows a status badge, pill or chip.
An app-owned page shows an inline alert, banner, notice or empty state.
An app-owned page puts buttons or links in its header beside the title.
An app-owned page groups content in cards, panels, sections or collapsibles.
The app has its own account pages (profile, security, password, preferences) at any URI, or uses the kit's settings frame. A bare settings/*.vue page is not enough: it may be app settings.
The app has its own workspace, team or organisation settings pages at any URI, or uses the kit's settings frame.
